jobs.title: Working Student Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Working Student Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)

As a Working Student Analytics Engineer, you will get hands-on with the systems and data that power decisions across the entire business. You will write real SQL, ship production dbt models, help maintain a modern data warehouse, and see your work land in the reports leadership actually runs on. This is a part-time (Werkstudent) role where you take ownership of your own small projects end to end, from raw data to actionable insight, with room to grow your responsibilities as your skills develop.

PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets, we build our data systems with the same care and precision as our products, guided by integrity, innovation, ambition, and unity.

What You'll Do

  • Help build and maintain our Snowflake data warehouse with dbt, and contribute to the migration of our ERP pipelines

  • Support the team in defining and developing core metrics that steer business performance

  • Build and iterate reports in Looker, turning raw data into insights the business acts on

  • Monitor data health, proactively flagging gaps, freshness issues, and quality problems

  • Take on your own small projects across the stack (Airbyte for ingestion, Snowflake as the warehouse, Python for the messy bits, dbt for transformation and orchestration) and ship them

What You'll Bring

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program (Data Science, Statistics, CS, Business Analytics, or related), or a solid self-taught track record

  • Solid SQL fundamentals, comfortable writing complex queries and full-fledged models well beyond a basic SELECT

  • Business intuition: before running a query, you weigh whether asking "why does this number look like that?" will drive real decisions

  • Technical curiosity about end-to-end data architecture and a critical mindset for getting the most out of AI tools while knowing where they fall short, plus professional working proficiency in English

  • Nice to have: exposure to dbt, Airbyte, Snowflake, Looker, or Python; familiarity with e-commerce data (Shopify, Klaviyo, GA4); a GitHub, portfolio, or side project you are proud to talk about

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, no endless unpaid crunch

🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will work alongside a lean, senior data team who explain the "why" instead of just handing you tickets, take real ownership of shippable projects from the start, gain full-stack exposure to a modern data platform and a live ERP migration, and build fast-track career momentum and a resume-worthy portfolio as PERGOLUX scales.

⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week per year remote workation in EU/UK

🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle

  • International, collaborative team, working with colleagues across Europe

  • Regular team events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work gatherings) and retreats

  • Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows)

  • Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products

  • Jobrad / Bike leasing program, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting

How to Apply

Ready to ship real data work while you study? Apply through our Career Page and connect with us on LinkedIn. We would love to see what you bring to the table.

PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, we think it's less about ticking every box and more about what you bring to the table!

Customer Support Engineer - London
jobs.description:
Customer Support Engineer - London

We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

As a Support Engineer at Heidi, you’ll apply deep technical expertise to diagnose, resolve, and prevent complex issues in our AI-powered healthcare product.

Your work directly impacts product reliability, customer trust, and Heidi’s ability to scale safely in high-stakes clinical environments. By owning technical issues end-to-end and partnering closely with engineering and product teams, you’ll play a critical role in supporting clinicians, improving patient care, and contributing to the long-term success of our company.

What you’ll do

  • Act as an escalation point for customers and internal team members on complex or technical issues particularly for escalated or high-impact cases.

  • Become a product expert, developing a deep understanding of how Heidi works and how customers use it in real-world clinical contexts.

  • Provide exceptional technical support by clearly understanding customer needs, communicating effectively, and resolving issues accurately and efficiently.

  • Perform in-depth analysis and debugging of complex technical issues, applying sound judgment and care in high-trust healthcare environments.

  • Own customer issues from initial contact through to resolution, ensuring timely, accurate responses within agreed service levels.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to understand, reproduce, and resolve complex technical problems - ensuring escalations are clearly documented well-scoped, and aligned with customer impact.

  • Monitor server health, system status, and bug reports, taking immediate action to mitigate impact, escalate critical issues, and prevent recurring problems.

  • Proactively identify systemic or recurring issues and contribute to improvements across tooling, processes, and systems that increase product reliability, support efficiency, and the team’s ability to scale, including helping identify and address recurring issues.

 

What you'll need

  • 2+ years’ experience in a support engineer role.

  • A proactive individual who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and enjoys collaborating with an international team dedicated to building impactful AI experiences.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and learn on the fly.

  • Strong customer focus - you excel at and genuinely enjoy helping customers.

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to question, clarify, empathise, use appropriate tone and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users in a clear, empathetic manner.

  • Understanding of web development, with some experience using Python, React, Node, FastAPI, and MongoDB.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer health and dental cover, a £700 annual learning and development budget, a £100/month health and wellness allowance, a £500 home office budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, four weeks of work from anywhere per year, and serious equity.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive III - NA

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role: At Camunda, we believe in empowering organizations to work smarter and deliver lasting impact. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll champion the adoption of process automation across North America - bringing innovation, transparency, and efficiency to government agencies. Join a passionate, collaborative team that values initiative, customer focus, and the drive to make a real difference on our customers’ digital transformation.

What You Will Do:

Driving ARR growth from new business and expansion of existing customers through complex sales cycles including; technical discovery and evaluations, presentations, financial and legal negotiations, and on-site customer meetings when necessary

Articulating Camunda’s value proposition and vision to multiple levels of technical and business leadership

Collaboration and partnering with Camunda Solutions Engineering, Product leaders, and Partners (GSI and Regional) to understand and support customer use cases

Leveraging multiple communication methods and collaboration with Account Development Representatives to create new contacts in middle and senior leadership in both technical and executive areas of the enterprise landscape.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • 7+ years of quota attainment within an Enterprise software (Saas) AE role

  • 3+ years of experience selling complex software solutions to Enterprise Healthcare, Life Sciences, Insurance, and/or medical tech companies (10k+ employees) by articulating business value and navigating complex buying centers across business and IT stakeholders

  • Proven track record of success selling $1M+ mutli-year contracts

  • Command of Sales Methodologies such as MEDDPICC and Challenger Sales

  • Track record of building new Pipeline generation via outbound campaigns

  • Ability to manage a high performing Account Teams, driving the strategy and execution of team members

  • Strong collaborator, innovator and problem solver

  • Adhere to our FAITH values

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-YW1 #LI-Remote #USEAST #USWEST

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $281,300.00 to $453,500.00

  • United Kingdom: £176,600.00 to £290,500.00

  • Singapore: S$349,400.00 to S$524,000.00

  • Canada: C$298,700 to C$491,300

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer (Integrations)
jobs.description:
Senior Electrical Engineer (Integrations)

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to lead our regional technical market-access and integration efforts.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to work with stakeholders to develop our DSR (Demand Side Response) and flexibility pipeline.

You will be bringing your regional technical expertise to aid the development of our asset integration technologies. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll bridge our software and hardware capabilities with the rigorous requirements of the four German Transmission System Operators (TSOs) and 900+ Distribution System Operators (DSOs).

The detailed Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware&Software) configuration and protocol engineering is owned by our UK-based team, whom you will feed with regional knowledge and design input, and who will support you on the technical aspects of how Kraken integrations work. You will own the regional relationship, the integration approach, and the design that the UK team then implements. The role may require you to attend customer calls, as well as calls with the TSO and DSOs to technically explain/defend our strategy.

You will join a team, based in Manchester, that is innovative and engineering-focused, with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Market Access & Prequalification: Drive the technical approach for connecting assets — mainly BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar) into German ancillary-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and Redispatch 3.0. Support prequalification (Präqualifikation) with the relevant TSO and ensure our telemetry and control approach satisfies TSO-specific and BNetzA requirements for market participation. (Grid-code and plant-compliance obligations such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; your focus is enabling market access, telemetry, and dispatch.)

  • Integration Technology (your core deliverable): Carry out research, engage technical stakeholders and engineers to design our established integration approaches for various asset types such as BESS, Wind, Solar, CHP and more. This can cover both new projects and retrofits.

  • Regional Technical Expertise: Be the regional authority who feeds and supports the UK team with knowledge of German hardware requirements, industrial protocols, connectivity, cyber-security expectations, and TSO/DSO and ancillary-service requirements. Help evaluate hardware and connectivity solutions for regional fit.

  • Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the technical point of contact for TSOs, DSOs, customers, and internal commercial teams to resolve connection, onboarding, or operational issues.

  • Hardware & On-site Support (occasional): Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O&Ms and third parties. However, occasional regional support and hands-on intervention may be required before or after a deployment, including some hardware handling and on-site engineering. You’ll ideally be based close to Kraken’s Berlin office and the role requires the ability to travel when needed, though this is kept to a minimum.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in German and English, essential for technical documentation and TSO/regulator communication.

  • Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration).

  • Integration & connectivity: Proven experience establishing industrial communication and connectivity between field equipment and external systems (telemetry and/or control).

  • Power-plant systems: Working understanding of power-plant control systems and instrumentation, including metering.

  • German market knowledge:

    • TSO/DSO hierarchy and the connection/integration process.

    • Ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) prequalification and technical requirements.

    • Redispatch 3.0 regulatory framework.

  • Customer-facing delivery: Ability to produce technical integration approaches and communicate them to customers, regulators, and internal teams.

  • Travel: Occasional travel may be required.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity of a multi-TSO, decentralised grid, and comfortable being the regional face of a technical function whose deep build sits with a partner team in the UK.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25 (wind), OPC-UA, Modbus, or similar IEC protocols.

  • Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness; IEC 62443 a plus).

  • Familiarity with CLI tools for configuring, diagnosing, and maintaining hardware or network connections in remote, Linux-based environments.

  • Familiarity with software languages, version-controlled configuration, and general tooling.

  • Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks beyond Germany.

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at ----- We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. The role

This is a high-agency, player-coach role designed for someone who:

  • Is technical enough to dive into logs, traces, and code to root-cause a gnarly customer issue, and leads by example doing it

  • Gets energy from growing people: coaching engineers, raising the bar on investigation quality, and building durable team rituals

  • Thinks in systems: replaces recurring toil with tooling, runbooks, and automation rather than re-solving the same ticket

  • Owns outcomes end-to-end: queue health, turnaround time, escalation quality, and the feedback loop back into Product and Engineering

You'll lead the Support Engineering team and partner closely with Customer Support, Customer Success, Product, and core Engineering to resolve issues fast and make Heidi more reliable at scale.

 

What you’ll do

Lead and grow the team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of support engineers; set a high standard for investigation rigour and customer communication.

  • Run the team's operating rhythm: queue triage, standups, case reviews, escalations and 1:1s.

  • Recruit, onboard, and ramp new support engineers as the function scales across regions.

  • Provide on-the-spot coaching during live incidents and complex escalations.

Own support engineering operations

  • Own queue health and SLAs across L2 support; ensure timely, high-quality resolution of customer-reported issues.

  • Track and report key metrics (response/resolution times, escalation and reopen rates, root-cause categories) and turn them into action.

  • Handle the most complex or sensitive technical escalations personally.

  • Triage customer reports into well-scoped tickets with clear reproduction steps, evidence, and impact for core Engineering.

  • Collaborate with the local region Customer Success and Sales teams to identify and share pain points for our customers

Investigate and resolve hard technical issues

  • Root-cause customer issues across the stack using logs, traces, and observability (e.g. Datadog), session data, and the codebase.

  • Ship pragmatic data fixes and tightly-scoped code fixes where appropriate, and partner with Engineering to land deeper fixes.

  • Use and extend internal tooling to resolve issues safely at scale via permissioned access to internal data and actions.

Turn signal into durable improvement

  • Spot recurring issues and product pain points; codify "tribal knowledge" into runbooks, checks, and self-serve internal interfaces.

  • Drive systemic fixes — feed clear, prioritised signals into Product and Engineering and follow them through to resolution.

  • Maintain and improve internal and customer-facing support content based on real ticket trends.

 

What you'll need

  • Strong technical troubleshooting ability: comfortable reading logs/traces, querying data, and navigating a production codebase to root-cause issues.

  • A romantic streak about software. You believe great products can transform someone's day.

  • Experience leading or mentoring engineers — formal management or strong tech-lead / player-coach experience.

  • Excellent written communication — you can translate messy customer problems into clear technical narratives for engineers and clear updates for stakeholders.

  • High ownership: you define success, drive queue and quality outcomes, and deliver without heavy direction.

  • Pragmatic approach to reliability and safety, especially when actions can affect customers or clinical workflows.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

Software Engineer, Infrastructure - Self Managed Experience (SMX)

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're hiring for Self-Managed Experience (SMX) — the team responsible for making Camunda 8 deployable in a self-service way for customers who run their own infrastructure. SMX covers two areas of work: installation artifacts (Helm chart, Docker Compose, C8Run) and reference architectures & cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure).

This role sits primarily on the installation artifacts side — building, maintaining, and releasing the artifacts that ship Camunda 8 to every self-managed customer. You'll be fully embedded in that area day-to-day, but you'll work alongside the reference-architecture side of the team regularly, and SMX is actively working toward enabling every engineer to review and contribute across both stacks over time.

SMX is also shifting from a purely artifact- and ops-focused team toward one in which engineers bring customer judgment and product sense alongside technical depth. That means engaging directly with the teams closest to customers — Support, Consulting, Presales — and using that signal to help shape what we prioritize, not just executing a fully-specced ticket.

You'll find plenty of room to leave your own footprint: deployment automation, software and infrastructure testing, multi-region setups, and developer experience are all live areas of investment as the team matures from "basic install" toward full-lifecycle ownership (upgrades, backup/restore, disaster recovery).

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Build, maintain, and release C8 distribution artifacts for self-managed customers — Helm Charts (Kubernetes), C8Run, and Docker Compose — along with their documentation.

  • Improve the reliability and usability of deployment artifacts across the full customer lifecycle: installation, upgrades, and day-2 operations, not just initial deployment.

  • Engage directly with internal customer-facing teams (Support, Consulting, Presales) to understand real deployment problems, and use that signal to help shape what gets prioritized — not just how it gets built. Collaborate with Development Teams, Product Management, QA, and Documentation to ship integrated, tested, and documented releases.

  • Take part in the team's shared medic rotation and resolve engineering-level support cases, feeding learnings back into development.

  • Contribute to the shared tooling (review, deployment, and test tooling) that SMX is building so other Camunda teams can adopt it — this is one of the team's current investment areas.

What success looks like (first ~3 months):

  • Taken on your first medic rotation slot and support tickets to understand the stack, customer challenges, and deployment environments.

  • Improved onboarding or documentation, turning your own ramp-up experience into concrete improvements.

  • Contributed to artifact fixes, CI/CD enhancements, or test automation that strengthens release quality.

  • Deliver structural improvement initiatives — a feature request, or a test/release improvement.

  • Built working relationships with engineering, QA, and product peers, and started building context on the reference-architecture side of the team.

  • Started forming your own view of a customer pain point from firsthand signal (support tickets, consulting feedback), not just from a ticket description.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product, with genuine curiosity about the customer problem behind a ticket — comfortable asking "should we build this" as well as "how do we build this."

  • Strong expertise in building, operating, and maintaining Helm Charts; deploying applications on Kubernetes; implementing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions; and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).

  • Ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate effectively across teams.

  • A pragmatic and autonomous approach to programming and problem-solving.

  • You thrive as a manager of one — you build it, you own it — and take pride in delivering maintainable, operable software.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience running and operating on-prem/self-hosted software on Docker.

  • Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar observability tools.

  • Working knowledge of the Go programming language.

  • Exposure to cloud infrastructure/IaC (Terraform, Crossplane) — useful as SMX moves toward shared review capability across installation artifacts and reference architectures.

jobs.description:
Senior Business Travel Consultant - Flexible Shift

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Location: Fully remote, with occasional in-person days at Birmingham Hub

Hours: A split shift built around the school day — 9:00am–2:30pm and 5:30pm–8:30pm, with the afternoon free for pickups, appointments, or whatever else needs doing. If you've been ruling out full-time roles because nothing fits around your kids' schedule, this one's designed to.

We're looking for an experienced Business Travel Consultant to join our Birmingham-hub team on a shift pattern that actually works around family life. Same great role, work, just split across the day so you're free for maybe the school run without giving up full-time hours or pay.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle travel bookings, amendments, and cancellations for business travellers with a focus on quality service

  • Arrange European and domestic travel including flights, car rentals, and hotels

  • Manage client communications via live chat, phone, and email

  • Work autonomously on client enquiries and maintain GDS queues

  • Mentor junior team members and quality-check their work

  • Develop client relationships throughout the travel lifecycle

Required Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of Galileo or Amadeus GDS systems, including ticket reissuing

  • Proficiency in air fares and ticketing

  • Previous business travel consultant experience

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)

  • Strong organisational skills and ability to work under pressure

  • Professional telephone manner and client-facing confidence

  • Comfortable managing a split-shift routine and picking work back up mid-evening

Desirable Qualities

  • Proactive problem-solving approach

  • Flexibility and willingness to support team needs across both shift blocks

  • Positive attitude toward colleagues, suppliers, and customers

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Working Hours & Conditions

  • Working hours are flexible to accommodate school picks up during the day.

  • Role will be fully remote however you will be required to come into the Birmingham Hub for training and special events.


Interview Process

GDS Test - Online
Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Team lead + Team manager interview - 90 Min virtual
Final interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. About the Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend on Camunda’s Distributed Systems team, you’ll help build and evolve the durable, highly available, horizontally scalable streaming platform that underpins Camunda 8’s Orchestration Cluster and powers mission‑critical processes for customers around the world.

As part of the Distributed Systems team, you will work on technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as expanding on our multi-Raft implementation, our SWIM-based cluster membership algorithm, or high performance network and disk I/O pipelines.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

  • Improve engineering effectiveness by collaborating with DevOps and other Core Application teams on CI, testing, and local development workflows to reduce PR time‑to‑merge and the overhead of working on multiple features in parallel.

  • Participate in L3 support and on‑call rotations, partnering closely with Support and SRE to investigate and resolve complex, performance‑sensitive production issues, and feeding what you learn back into our product and platform.

Must Haves:

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role:

We are seeking a dedicated Senior Business Travel Consultant that is passionate about enhancing the experience of business travelers and is an expert in the Galileo or Amadeus system.

Our Customer Care team is crucial to our company's success and growth. We value empathetic professionals who understand our mission: making business travelers happy! 

If you are a problem solver driven by delivering a 7-Star service and eager to make an impact and revolutionize corporate travel management, you might be the perfect fit for our team. 

What You Will Do:

  • Provide first-class, 7-star service to business travelers, managing travel bookings, amendments, and cancellations efficiently.

  • Arrange European and domestic travel, including flights, car rentals, and hotels.

  • Work independently, using your initiative to handle client inquiries and provide solutions without supervision.

  • Communicate with clients via live chat, telephone, and email, ensuring all interactions are professional, friendly, and accurate.

We Are Looking for People Who:

  • Have great communication skills, fluency in English, both written and spoken is essential.

  • Have previous experience as a Business Travel Consultant.

  • Exhibit a positive and professional telephone manner, with confidence in interacting with clients and suppliers.

  • Are proactive in resolving customer queries and complaints, using their initiative to overcome problems.

  • Are flexible and willing to complete various tasks as needed, supporting the team and contributing to overall success.

  • Maintain a professional and positive attitude when dealing with suppliers, customers, and colleagues.

  • Motivate and encourage the well-being of the team, displaying a positive attitude at all times.

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Working Hours & Conditions

  • Permanent nights

  • Role will be fully remote however you will be required to come into the Birmingham Hub for training and special events.



Interview Process

  1. GDS Test - Online

  2. Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  3. Team lead + Team manager interview - 90 Min virtual

  4. Final interview with Director of Customer Care - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Senior AI Product Manager (f/m/d)

OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades: Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload.

This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. You’ll own an emerging problem space and identify where agents can create the highest leverage for our customers beyond what Plancraft does today. That means getting close to tradespeople and their businesses, uncovering the problems worth solving, and working with Engineering and UX to turn them into reliable, trustworthy products customers are willing to rely on for real work.

You’ll operate across the full product journey: from spending time with tradespeople in the field and deciding which opportunity to pursue, to working with Engineering to understand technical requirements and trade-offs, defining evaluation criteria, shipping to production, and learning from real-world usage.

The impact should be tangible. The products you build will aim to help trades businesses improve outcomes such as profit margins, quote acceptance rates, and capacity utilisation — while opening up entirely new product and growth opportunities for plancraft.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Plancraft’s customer-facing AI agents and workflows.

  • Identify high-potential customer problems beyond today’s platform and translate messy, real-world trades workflows into focused opportunities for agentic products.

  • Define and own the single co-worker interface for customers to interact with and manage agents and their underlying workflows.

  • Work in a Product Trio with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, evaluation, and delivery, from early problem validation to production-quality releases.

  • Establish a repeatable AI product operating loop across discovery, evaluation, release gates, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Define and maintain evaluation sets, quality standards, and release criteria for customer-facing AI products, including accuracy, correction rates, latency, and safe rollback conditions.

  • Instrument and monitor AI product performance, using customer behaviour and quality signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop.

  • Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes from AI-powered workflows, including improvements in efficiency, profitability, quote acceptance, capacity utilisation, activation, and retention.

  • Contribute the Product perspective to technical and platform trade-offs, including customer value, quality, cost, and time to market, together with Engineering and the shared AI infrastructure counterpart.

  • Partner across Product and Engineering to manage dependencies, reusable AI experience patterns, mobile and voice input, and handovers between customer workflows.

  • Work closely with RevOps, Sales, and Customer Success to understand adoption and willingness-to-pay signals and contribute to AI pricing and monetisation experiments.

Must-Have Skills

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years owning and shipping AI products in production end-to-end.

  • Strong applied GenAI literacy across LLMs, agents, RAG, and evaluation frameworks — sufficient to understand technical requirements and help evaluate Product, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs together with Engineering.

  • Experience building 0-to-1 AI products or new product areas, from customer discovery and problem definition through production launch and iteration.

  • Experience defining quality and success criteria for AI products, including evaluation metrics, release thresholds, customer outcomes, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Strong customer discovery and product judgment, with the ability to turn complex real-world workflows into focused AI product opportunities.

  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment, with a track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and delivering despite ambiguity.

  • Proven cross-functional ownership, working closely with Engineering and UX from discovery through production and managing dependencies across teams.

  • English at C1 level and German at C2 level.

  • Willingness to stay close to customers and the team, including field discovery with tradespeople and regular presence in Hamburg (approximately one week per month or equivalent).

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with voice, mobile, or document AI, particularly products that turn unstructured inputs into reliable workflows.

  • Experience with AI monetisation, including usage-based, credit-based, or hybrid pricing models.

  • Background in B2B SaaS for SMBs, field service, construction, or the trades.

  • Familiarity with product and research tools such as PostHog, Sentry, Dovetail, or ProductFruits.

  • Additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you want to build rather than inherit.

You like starting with an important but not fully defined problem and creating clarity through customer insight, data, experimentation, and strong product judgment. You’re excited by AI because of the problems it can solve — not simply because the technology is new.

You’re comfortable working closely with engineers, understanding technical requirements and evaluation results, and translating them into sound Product decisions.

You want meaningful ownership. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, narrowing a large opportunity space into the right first wedge, shipping it, learning from real usage, and changing course when the evidence tells you to.

And importantly, you want your work to have a visible outcome. The products you build here should change how trades businesses operate — and their adoption, customer value, and commercial impact will be measurable.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

Senior Engineering Manager (Hands-on) - Offer

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 The Offer Area

We’re the engine that decides what Alan sells, at what price, and on what terms.

Every Alan member, from a 3-person startup to a public administration body with 200K+ collaborators is covered by an offer that our area designed, priced, contracted and renews every year.

We own the whole offer lifecycle for several kind of services (health insurance, life & disability insurance, employee benefits) across 4 countries. We manage an incredible business complexity and diversity in a scalable way, and most importantly, we empower others to act autonomously on it:

  • Offer creation: Enabling Sales to build compliant and relevant offers themselves in minutes, with a real-time pricer and AI assistance, without waiting days for an actuary.

  • Contract Lifecycle: Not only signing a contract in one go and writing the settings that become the source of truth for the rest of Alan, but also providing Business Ops with the tools they need to pilot over the years a portfolio of 100K+ contracts

  • Enabling growth: We’re at the root of Alan’s Insurance stack. Our technical decisions have a long reach: Claims, Billing and many other teams depends on us. We are key to lift blockers and enable the opening of new segments or markets.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

  • 🌍 One insurance stack for every country. We're replacing country-by-country code with a shared "Core Stack": one set of shared rules, with room for local differences. Spain already runs on it, and we’re now tackling France. The architecture decisions you make will shape how Alan sells insurance for the next 10 years. (How we made our offer builder global)

  • 🤖 AI-native underwriting. Insurance is complex, and most insurers need actuaries on every quote. We empower our Sales to build compliant and relevant offers themselves in minutes. AI-assisted smart alternatives, price explanations, pitching and more are already in the Sales hands, and there’s much more to build.

  • 🛡️ Life & Disability as a first-class product: We’re bringing this historically smaller product at Alan to the same level of maturity as Health, with first class member XP, Ops and enabling access to a much wider population.

  • 🧑‍🚀 A growing team. You'll hire it, shape it, and decide what it works on. Talent density, onboarding, feedback, and the mix of skills the area needs are yours to own.

  • 🛡️ Technical direction and operational excellence. Architecture calls, quality standards and shaping the organization and incident response as we scale to more countries. And you stay hands-on: at Alan, engineering leaders are expected to build.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth, engineers become better while building better products

  • Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

  • Your users sit next to you: Hundred of Alaners use what your team ships every day. The feedback loop between building and impact is very short, which allows you to iterate and move quickly.

  • Complex domain, simple software: Regulated domain, many countries, many segments… The job is to model a messy real world into a stack that stays simple and easy to extend.

  • Direct business impact. We own pricing, contract lifecycle and Sales tooling. We have a direct impact on Alan’s margin and growth.

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where this role sits.

Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organisation that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Your job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own.

That means working across every level of the customer's organisation. With operational teams you build understanding and find where automation is actually blocked. With department leads you challenge the process rules that make full automation impossible, and drive the decisions that change them. And you use the right lever for each blocker, because they are all different: some are a data clean-up you coordinate with the customer, some are a training and adoption gap, some need a custom agent, and some are structural and belong with our engineering teams.

You do not do this alone. You enable the customer's core team to solve their own issues, you work with our Customer Success Engineers on the technical side, and you use the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made where you need commercial weight. For our smaller customers, where there is no Customer Success Manager, you are the escalation point yourself.

You own customer health. Your sharpest measure of it is the automation rate.

What you'll do

  • Own customer health across your portfolio, measured first and foremost by automation rates.

  • Lead the transition to AI-native ways of working: identify what blocks automation, and pick the right way to solve each blocker.

  • Work with operational teams on enablement and adoption, so people work efficiently with blp rather than around it.

  • Challenge process rules that prevent automation, and drive improvements with the department leads who can decide.

  • Coordinate data clean-up with the customer where master data quality is capping what automation can reach.

  • Enable the customer's core team to resolve issues themselves, and reduce what has to come to us at all.

  • Identify where a custom agent solves the problem, and where the issue is structural and belongs with our engineering teams.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success Engineers on technical topics, and with the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made.

  • For customers without a Customer Success Manager, act as the escalation point for SLA breaches and own continuity of operations.

  • Direct the AI Automation Specialists working on your accounts.

What we're really looking for

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Process Excellence – You understand core business processes deeply, P2P and O2C, and you can see why a process is shaped the way it is and what it could look like instead.

  • Client Hands – You bring customers with you. You are strict on the things that matter and flexible on the things that do not, you understand the context people are working in, and you have more than one way of convincing them.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take a customer from live to high automation without being told the steps.

  • Comfort in the Data – You go into the numbers yourself to find where automation is leaking.

  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You separate a configuration symptom from a process cause, and pick the right lever for each.

What you'll bring

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in consulting, process improvement, shared services, or ERP process ownership.

  • Deep working knowledge of at least one core business process end to end, purchase-to-pay or order-to-cash. This is a prerequisite, not a nice to have.

  • Demonstrable experience changing how a finance, procurement or supply chain team actually works, not only advising on it.

  • Strong analytical skills. You are comfortable working with process and transaction data directly.

  • Confident facilitating workshops with operational teams and presenting to their leadership.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for experience with ERP systems, accounts payable or order management processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

What you'll get

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
What we do

At Briink, we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video

  1. Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
  2. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
  3. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)


Your role

As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer, you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals.

This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket.

You will:

  • Own product features end to end, from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement.
  • Design and build scalable backend systems, including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products.
  • Build and ship applied AI/LLM features, such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows
  • Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation.
  • Improve the robustness of our systems, strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale.
  • Work directly with users, product, and data, using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works.
  • Prototype and test new AI capabilities, turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap.
  • Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge, helping the team make better product and technical decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers, including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving.


Your profile

Technical requirements

  • Strong professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems.
  • Experience in a small, high-ownership product team, ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers.
  • Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end, rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation.
  • Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly).
  • Strong API, database, and systems design skills, with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products.
  • Applied AI/LLM experience: you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems.
  • A solid software-quality mindset, including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security.
  • Cloud and container experience, with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads.
  • Fluent English (C1+), both written and spoken. 
Nice to have
  • Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues 
  • Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks
  • Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems.
  • Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads.
  • Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting.
  • German language skills.
Who you are
  • Kind and collaborative: You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment.
  • Mission-driven: You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action.
  • Sharp and curious: You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems.
  • A product-minded builder: You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value.
  • Highly self-directed: You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight.
  • Pragmatic and action-oriented: You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Opinionated but open-minded: You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others.
