jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
jobs.description:
CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware

The question

Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325–580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix–vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply–accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. The quantisation literature for diffusion models reports image-quality scores; the induced L 2 score error, in the form the convergence theory needs, is directly measurable and goes unreported. One open sub-question sets the direction: the distinction between an error redrawn at each evaluation, as in stochastic computing, and an error frozen at write time, as in deterministic quantisation, has been settled in one setting only, and not the one hardware lives in; carrying it over is what this position exists to do. The work is judged on one concrete outcome. For at least one architecture, we want to show that theenergy gain from moving the score evaluation off digital CMOS is real, measured where it survives integration and not extrapolated from a single tile, and that it is paid for by a loss in sample quality that is small and, above all, tunable: a knob the designer sets, whose position the theory predicts rather than discovers afterwards.

What you will do

The work is organised in four packages, summarised below; the full research programme is available from the supervisors on request.

1. Make the score error measurable, starting from Gaussian targets where the whole error decomposition is closed-form. You will report the induced score error for a given perturbation of the network’s arithmetic, the number the theory needs and the quantisation literature does not report.

2. Map device physics onto the theory. Propagate the published error models for the technologies INL works on through the score network into an explicit score-error budget, separating what is proved from what is measured.

3. Extend the guarantees. Existing bounds assume a deterministic oracle, or a benign randomised one; extend them to error that is part frozen at write time and part redrawn at each call, and settle, on the way, which process the score error should be controlled along.

4. Co-design with INL, and deliver the proof of concept. Turn the score-error budget into an energy– accuracy frontier for INL’s PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine, using device-calibrated circuitlevel models; a FeFET-based analog alternative may be considered where appropriate. Jointly vary sampler steps, stochastic bitstream length and effective precision to identify an operating point predicted to yield a real energy advantage over digital CMOS at a small, tunable loss in sample quality. The result is a frontier predicted from mathematical and hardware models, then verified against calibrated measurements.

A clear negative answer is more useful to us than a vague positive one: a negative result on point 3 leaves points 1 and 2 intact and turns point 4 from a prediction into a measurement.


Who we are looking for Required

• A PhD in applied mathematics, statistics, machine learning, electronic engineering, computer science or a closely related field, obtained (or with the defence scheduled) before the start of the contract.

• A strong foundation in probability and stochastic analysis, numerical analysis, optimisation, or machine learning: SDEs, Girsanov’s theorem, time reversal of diffusions, with the ability to apply it rigorously to diffusion or other generative models.

• Familiarity with the convergence theory of sampling algorithms, or the demonstrated capacity to acquire it quickly, for example through Langevin/MCMC analysis, optimal transport or concentration of measure.

• Solid scientific computing (PyTorch or JAX), and the habit of writing code others can run. Ability and motivation to work across mathematical modelling and hardware-aware AI.

• Working English; French is not required.

Valued, not required

Prior work on diffusion or score-based generative models; numerical analysis of finite-precision arithmetic. Familiarity with hardware-aware machine learning, approximate or stochastic computing, analogue in-memory computing, device modelling, circuit simulation, photonics, ferroelectric devices, or energy modelling. Experience linking model accuracy or robustness to implementation non-idealities, such as quantisation, noise, drift, variability, finite precision, or correlated errors. Evidence of interdisciplinary research, for example work at the interface of mathematics, machine learning, devices, circuits, architectures, or electronic-design automation. No hardware experience is expected or needed to apply.

What matters most

We are seeking a researcher who wants to explore how to turn physical constraints into mathematical and architectural design parameters. The project does not require prior laboratory hardware experience: INL provides device expertise, measured characteristics and modelling infrastructure. However, the successful candidate must be prepared to engage critically with non-ideal analog, photonic and ferroelectric accelerators, and to work with both supervisors to connect device-level error mechanisms, score-error guarantees and the energy–quality trade-off of diffusion-model inference. Candidates with a primarily mathematical background and strong curiosity for hardware are welcome, as are candidates from AIhardware, device-modeling, circuit, architecture or EDA backgrounds who have the stochastic-analysis maturity needed to develop the theory. The decisive criterion is the ability to make the mathematics and hardware inform one another, producing predictions that are quantitative, testable and relevant to an energy-efficient accelerator demonstrator.

What we offer

• A real double supervision, with weekly meetings that alternate between ICJ and INL. The two laboratories are on the same campus, five minutes apart on foot.

• A question publishable on both sides: mathematics journals for the theory, design and hardware venues for the co-design.

• Involvement in INL’s design–technology co-optimisation work through the PEPR Électronique CHOOSE project, and contact with the group’s ferroelectric and photonic device work (FVLLMONTI, Ferro4EdgeAI).

• Support for conference travel and open-access publication, funded by the two host laboratories, and the career-development measures the establishment provides for post-doctoral researchers.

• Practical help for international recruits through Espace ULYS, the EURAXESS service centre for Université de Lyon: visas, housing, health cover, banking, schooling.

Conditions

Twelve-month fixed-term contract under French public law, full time (1 607 h annual reference), 25 working days of annual leave plus the RTT days of the establishment’s scheme. Affiliation to the régime général for health and to IRCANTEC for supplementary pension; employer contribution to complementary health cover under the scheme in force at the establishment; 75 % reimbursement of publictransport season tickets, up to the statutory ceiling. The exact number of RTT days is set by the establishment.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
What we do

At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung.
Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. 


Deine Aufgaben 

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps.
  • Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic-basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter.
  • Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich.
  • Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents– zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures.
  • Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign.
  • Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment-Prozesse mit.
  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen.
  • Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: 

  • PHP und Laravel
  • Statamic
  • PostgreSQL
  • Livewire
  • HTML, CSS und JavaScript
  • RESTful APIs
  • Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment-Prozessen
  • Large Language Models und Coding Agents
Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. 
Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt.


Qualifikation

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken.
  • Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich inLaravel,Statamic, PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und CodingAgentssinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen.
  • Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern,Deploymentund grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.
  • Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten.
  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert.
  • Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich.

Was uns wichtig ist

Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren.
Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst.


Benefits

Wir bieten dir: 

  • Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen
  • Die Möglichkeit,unseren Tech-Stackaktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln

  • Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten Wachstumskultur

Deine Bewerbung

jobs.title: Director Marketing (all genders) - GPORTAL (Ociris GmbH)
jobs.description:
Director Marketing (all genders) - GPORTAL (Ociris GmbH)
Your creative field

At GPORTAL, our vision is to build individual and easy-to-use online gaming experiences for the world. Driven by our “from gamer for gamer” passion, we've grown into one of the leading game server providers - offering more than just servers, unlike other hosting companies. For over 20 years, we've been bringing virtual worlds into people's homes with just a few clicks. Our mission: enabling experts and beginners alike to play their favourite games together with their friends. From Palworld and Enshrouded to Minecraft and Battlefield, we offer around 100 multiplayer games across every genre.


GPORTAL is looking for a Director Marketing who is ready to take the wheel of our entire marketing department, performance marketing, social media, partner management, community management, and graphic design. Reporting directly to our CEO, you will be part of the core management team from day one, with the kind of ownership over people and KPIs you will not find in every gaming company.

In your first six months, the priority is simple: keep the team running strong while you get a real feel for GPORTAL's business, our vision, and where we are headed. You will take full budget responsibility, from managing current spend and staying on top of marketing invoices to building the annual forecast. You will also size up the market to derive strategic conclusions on where we push next.

From there, you settle in as a driving force in our management team and sharpen how the marketing department works so it is well set up for the future. That includes working hand in hand with our tech teams on product-related topics such as checkout flows or game updates and launches. You also take full responsibility for onboarding, managing, and offboarding our external agencies and freelancers. On top of that, you build real connections with the marketing team over at Contabo Group to create synergies wherever possible. Just as important: brand visibility and closeness to the community. GPORTAL is a love brand to its players, and that needs to show up in the social channels and communication tools where our community actually lives.

Alongside that, you own our marketing campaigns with partner studios and the big moments like Black Friday. Last but not least, you advise our CEO directly on D2C pricing based on comprehensive market assessments, both the operative calls today and the strategic thinking further out.

Longer term, you push the KPIs that matter and build retention measures that keep players around. You also shape a team structure that can scale with us. That also means preparing and presenting marketing reporting and KPIs at Group and shareholder level. And you run and assess customer surveys, turning what you learn into decisions we actually act on.

Gaming is a volatile business, and the classic playbook does not always deliver a straight line to growth. We are all pulling for the same outcome for the wider group, which sometimes means short-term compromises we make together. In practice, that also means staying flexible and genuinely meeting people face to face rather than just online.


What convinces us

Ideally, you would have:

  • a strong, hands-on track record leading holistic marketing departments, from performance marketing to social, community, and creative, backed by solid marketing controlling, budget management, and core KPI skills
  • real performance marketing experience, paired with the ability to genuinely inspire a team toward a shared goal
  • some background in IT or hosting, plus experience working with external agencies and freelancers
  • gaming industry exposure is a nice-to-have, though a genuine feel for gaming culture matters just as much as the industry on your CV
  • some exposure to influencer management or social media marketing, and enough confidence to step into a thought-leader role in the market when needed
  • strong communication skills and a knack for handling conflict head-on, with a strategic, analytical mindset that connects campaigns to business outcomes
  • a proactive, hands-on, reliable way of working, comfortable holding yourself to a high bar under pressure
  • an open, global, adaptable mindset with genuine passion for the product and enough flexibility to compromise when the business needs it
  • fluent German and English
 
If this job offer has sparked your interest, please do reach out to us, even if you only meet some of the requirements. We'd love to get to know each other!


Awesome Prospects

  • Make an impact – Take ownership and be part of one of the most exciting growth stories in the industry
  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours and the setup you need to perform at your best
  • Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
  • Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and a wide range of fitness and wellness options
  • Dive into real challenges – Work on a wide range of technical topics that keep things exciting and far from routine
  • Keep growing – Develop your skills through hands-on experience, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning as a team
  • Learn from the best – Work alongside experienced, open-minded colleagues who support each other and share their knowledge·         
  • Create lasting memories – Join us for workshops and company events where we come together multiple times a year (yes, fully covered)
  • Give back – Take a day off to support social causes through our Volunteer Day
  • Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
  • Have fun along the way – Most people here would say we enjoy what we do… but we’ll let you be the judge


How to reach us

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Katharina by email at katharina.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager (Full Remote - Europe)

Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most Product Manager roles are built around specs and handoffs, waiting on a designer's mockup, an engineer's sprint slot, a data analyst's report.

This role is built differently: we're hiring a PM who does more than decide what should be built. You'll steer a developer squad end to end: investigating opportunities, analyzing user behaviour, prototyping solutions with AI, contributing code, launching experiments, and improving what reaches production.

You'll work directly with Pierre Gerbaud, Product Lead, and Michael Monin, our Co-founder & CTO, on a product already used by more than 50 million people and growing toward 100 million users.

At this scale, every small improvement can create significant impact, and you'll have the space to spot these opportunities and act on them quickly.

If your first instinct is to test an idea by making it real, this is your role.

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the work end to end, not just a piece of it: Understand the problem, choose an approach, build the solution (AI-assisted coding, opening pull requests, working with internal tools), launch it, measure it, and iterate with as few handoffs as possible;

  • Build with AI every day: Use AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping, and debugging; as a genuine part of how you think and work, evolving with the tools as they improve;

  • Decide what's worth pursuing, and test it fast: When a dozen directions look plausible and there are more ideas than time, identify the opportunities that matter most and design the smallest meaningful experiment to test your assumptions;

  • Let the results determine what happens next: Define success before you build, analyse the outcome once the experiment is live, and use what you learn to improve, expand, or stop what you shipped;

  • Work embedded in a software engineering squad: partner directly with Leads, Co-founders, designers, and engineers to define and deliver priority projects, and communicate progress and decisions to all relevant stakeholders;

  • Keep momentum high: Surface blockers the moment they appear, challenge assumptions directly regardless of who made them, and find another route forward when the obvious one is blocked;

 

Your Qualifications

  • You build with AI: you’ve personally built and shipped a functional feature, experiment, prototype, workflow, or tool using AI coding tools. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools are already part of how you work everyday;

  • You use data to make product decisions: you can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next;

  • You explore AI independently: you actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate directly: you work effectively with designers, engineers, and other stakeholders, ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent in English;

  • You care about the user experience: you take pride in the quality of what reaches users, and pay attention to whether the product is useful, intuitive, and engaging;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have enough design fluency to prompt a usable UI independently

  • You’ve worked at a fast-scaling D2C/consumer tech company or scale-up

  • You have experience on consumer-facing features

  • You have experience in Entertainment, Avatars, Gaming, or any high-touch media industry

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented CAD & Stress Analyst to help us in our mission by designing and structurally justifying the hardware that makes up our propulsion systems, with a particular focus on the Thrust Chamber Assembly(TCA). You will own parts from initial CAD layout through to final stress justification, working hand in hand with the manufacturing and test teams to bring flight hardware from concept to qualified design.

Key responsibilities

In your capacity as a CAD & Stress Analyst, you will be responsible for the on-time and on-cost design and structural justification of propulsion hardware, with the TCA as your primary scope.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Design the thrust chamber & injector propulsion hardware in CAD, from concept layout through to detailed design.

  • Perform stress analysis (hand calculations and FEA) on designed parts to substantiate margins of safety under mechanical, thermal and pressure loads.

  • Select materials and define manufacturing processes in coordination with manufacturing engineering, accounting for structural, thermal and producibility constraints.

  • Work closely with propulsion, thermal and fluidic system engineers to translate functional requirements into part-level design and load cases.

  • Establish and maintain interface definitions, drawings and part datasets, ensuring configuration control and traceability.

  • Conduct trade studies on design options (geometry, material, manufacturing route) and justify design decisions with analysis.

  • Elaborate and maintain structural analysis reports supporting design reviews and qualification.

  • Support the definition of test requirements needed to validate analytical models and structural assumptions.

  • Produce and maintain technical documentation of design choices and trade-offs, to a high standard, capturing analysis methods and results as to serve as reference justification for the design.

During Manufacturing, Assembly and Test Phase:

  • Support manufacturing and inspection of parts, resolving design or tolerance issues as they arise.

  • Support root-cause investigations of any structural anomaly or test finding, correlating analysis with hardware behaviour.

  • Update and correlate stress models and analyses based on test and inspection results.

  • Support design iterations and upgrades based on test campaign outcomes.

What we would love to see from you

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering or similar degrees.

  • Over 1 year of related experience in CAD design and stress analysis of mechanical or structural hardware, ideally in a propulsion, aerospace or high-reliability environment.

  • Strong CAD skills, able to take a part from concept to a fully detailed, manufacturable design.

  • Solid grounding in structural/stress analysis, including hand calculations and FEA (e.g. Ansys, Abaqus, or equivalent).

  • Familiarity with manufacturing processes (machining, additive manufacturing, welding/brazing) and their impact on design and structural performance.

  • Nice to have: CFD experience, for thermal or flow-related analysis of propulsion hardware.

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across departments.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

Dans le cadre du projet “Horizon Europe EMPOWR” nous recrutons un post-doctorat en réalité augmentée. Sous la responsabilité de Guillaume MOREAU et en collaboration avec les membres de l’équipe INUIT, les principales tâches du poste sont :

 

  1. Définir un design space pour l’affichage d’informations pertinentes relatives à des tâches complexes

  2.  Construire l’outil de réalité augmentée adaptatif ainsi que les connecteurs avec les autres composants logiciels développés dans le projet

  3. Préparer le déploiement de l’outil de réalité augmentée adaptatif pour les deux cas d’usage industriels du projet

  4. Participer à des activités annexes du projet EMPOWR

 

  1. Définir un design space pour l’affichage d’informations pertinentes relatives à des tâches complexes

  • Collecte des tâches d’augmentation auprès des partenaires

  • Construction du design space des augmentations (où, quand, quoi, comment)

2. Construire l’outil de réalité augmentée adaptatif ainsi que les connecteurs avec les autres composants logiciels développés dans le projet

  • Développe un outil de réalité augmentée à l’aide de composants génériques

  • Implémente l’interface de mise en œuvre du design space

  • Définit les interfaces avec les autres composants logiciels du projet

3. Préparer le déploiement de l’outil de réalité augmentée adaptatif pour les deux cas d’usage industriels

  • Participe à la spécification détaillée des cas d’usage

  • Définit les exigences spécifiques pour le module de réalité augmentée

  • Participe à et superviser le développement de leur mise en œuvre

4. Participer à des activités annexes du projet EMPOWR

  • Participe à la rédaction des livrables

  • Participe aux assemblées générales du projet ainsi qu’aux réunions techniques

  • Rédige des publications scientifiques

Le Projet

L’objectif principal du projet EMPOWR est d’introduire un écosystème d’augmentation multicouches qui transformera les espaces de travail industriels en environnements adaptatifs et intelligents, où les travailleurs ne seront plus simplement des opérateurs, mais des décideurs améliorés. Cet écosystème favorisera la collaboration homme-machine grâce à deux technologies clés : un outil de réalité augmenté adaptatif, accompagné d’un compagnon IA cognitif, Adaptive Learning Manufacturing Assistant (ALMA ), un système d’IA basé sur des modèles de langage (LLM) qui jouera le rôle d’intelligence de l’espace de travail industriel.

L’équipe

L’équipe INUIT (Interaction Naturelle Immersive pour l’Utilisateur) du département Informatique mène des recherches sur l’interaction en réalité mixte en concevant des systèmes de réalité virtuelle et augmentée, en proposant des modèles et des métaphores évalués par des expériences utilisateurs. Les domaines d’application incluent notamment l’Industrie du Futur, la Santé, la Défense et le Patrimoine Culturel.

L’équipe INUIT est responsable de la conception et du développement de l’outil de réalité augmentée adaptatif. jobs.description:
Stage - Contrôle de Gestion & Data / Performance (H/F)

Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.

Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs.

Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé.

Rattaché(e) au Responsable Contrôle de Gestion, vous serez au cœur du pilotage de la performance et de la structuration de la donnée financière. Vous ferez le lien entre les équipes opérationnelles et la finance : analyser, fiabiliser et automatiser l'information pour aider les équipes à décider vite et bien, sur la performance commerciale comme sur les dépenses d'exploitation.

Au-delà du contrôle de gestion classique, vous contribuerez directement à nos chantiers data : construction d'une base CA/Marge unifiée et automatisation des reportings récurrents. Un vrai terrain de jeu pour un profil qui aime croiser finance et outils.

Missions

1. Analyse de la performance commerciale et du forecast

  • Assurer l'analyse hebdomadaire des installations, du sell-out et des stocks distributeurs.
  • Mettre à jour ces données dans notre outil de planification Anaplan et alerter sur les principales variations.
  • Participer aux revues mensuelles de forecast avec les équipes commerciales pour analyser la cohérence et les écarts au budget.

2. Suivi de la performance opérationnelle et des OPEX

  • Aider l'équipe finance à déployer le suivi des dépenses d'exploitation (OPEX) par service.
  • Analyser et présenter les suivis OPEX aux responsables budgétaires, avec un vrai rôle d'alerte sur les dérives.

3. Automatisation et fiabilisation du reporting

  • Contribuer à la construction et à la fiabilisation de notre base de données CA/Marge (réconciliation multi-sources SAP et e-commerce).
  • Automatiser des reportings récurrents (Net Margin, OPEX, Flash Finance) via requêtes et outils dédiés.
  • Participer aux analyses liées aux nouveaux flux : migration Shopify, partenariats B2B et nouveaux projets d'intégration.

4. Gestion des outils et analyses ad-hoc

  • Assurer la collecte, la mise à jour et la fiabilité des données dans nos outils de pilotage.
  • Réaliser des analyses ponctuelles pour les autres services : prévisions d'installations pour le service client, estimation des volumes des nouveaux produits, etc.

Requirements

  • Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, d'ingénieur ou cursus finance / data, en césure ou en fin d'études, avec une première approche du contrôle de gestion et un vrai intérêt pour la donnée.
  • Excellente maîtrise d'Excel : formules avancées, TCD, modélisation.
  • Appétence forte pour la data et l'automatisation. Des notions de SQL et / ou Python sont un vrai plus et pourront être développées pendant le stage.
  • La connaissance d'Anaplan et/ou SAP est un atout.
  • Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous gérez plusieurs sujets en parallèle.
  • Autonome et curieux(se), vous prenez des initiatives et apprenez vite.
  • Excellent(e) communicant(e), vous aimez le travail en équipe et savez interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés.
  • Vous parlez couramment anglais.

Benefits

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

  • Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
  • Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
  • Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
  • Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore
  • Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !

Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des opinions, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.

jobs.description:
Director, Business Development

About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

Experience

  • Proven ability to close six-figure deals and manage multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in creative industries (luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, advertising) — a strong differentiator

Skills & Competencies

  • Hunter profile— proactive, autonomous, energised by opening new doors

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills— listens before pitching

  • Comfortable discussing technology, AI, and workflow solutions as well as creative services

Education

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays, faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français.

N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante, etc.

L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes.

Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 220 aujourd’hui, portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale.

Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.

En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple, un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).

Nous prévoyons de recruter 100 nouveaux collaborateurs d’ici 2027. Notre objectif est également d’accélérer la croissance de nos produits, ce qui passe par le renforcement de notre équipe de développement.

Quelques chiffres

  • 220 collaborateurs, dont 45 dans l'équipe tech

  • Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.

L’équipe tech

Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s, réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core…

Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA.

Stack et pratiques

Front : Angular 16/21

Back : .NET 10 – C#

Infra : AWS

BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

Architecture : monolithe modulaire

Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow.

Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning).


Le profil recherché

Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes :

  • D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum

  • De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend)

  • De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

  • D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL

  • D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker

Et tu fais preuve :

  • D'esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée

  • De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique

  • De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé.

Les points d’attention :

  • Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste.

  • Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle.

Les plus :

  • Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable

  • Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées

  • Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies

  • Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute

  • La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre

Processus de recrutement

  1. Préqualification avec nos recruteurs

  2. Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline)

  3. Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h)

  4. Entretien avec le CTO (40 min)

A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues.

Télétravail :

Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote, depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site.

Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe.

En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun, dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration.

Rémunération et avantages

  • 40–50k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique

Senior Sales Development Representative, Global Accounts (m/f/d)

We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

As a Senior Sales Development Representative, Global Accounts, you will play a key role in growing Berlitz’s relationships with large, strategic organisations around the world.

Working closely with our Global Account Managers, you will be responsible for identifying, mapping and engaging relevant stakeholders across a defined portfolio of named global enterprise accounts. A key part of the role is multi-stakeholder management — building and maintaining relationships across different levels, functions and regions within complex organisations. Your focus will be on building meaningful relationships, uncovering business needs and creating high-quality opportunities that can develop into long-term commercial partnerships.

This is a senior SDR role by design. You’ll need to operate with a high degree of ownership, navigate complex global organisations and engage confidently with stakeholders across multiple levels and functions.

Rather than relying on traditional top-down cold calling or high-volume outreach, you’ll take a bottom-up prospecting approach — researching accounts deeply, mapping multiple stakeholders, identifying potential internal champions and building relationships across different layers of an organisation.

You’ll work closely with Global Account Managers and other sales stakeholders to develop account strategies, share market insights and create new opportunities within some of Berlitz’s most strategically important accounts.

What You'll Do

  • Partner closely with Global Account Managers to develop and execute account-based prospecting strategies across named global enterprise accounts.

  • Research target organisations to understand their business, organisational structure, strategic priorities and potential learning, language or communication needs.

  • Take a bottom-up prospecting approach, mapping multiple layers of an organisation rather than relying solely on top-down outreach.

  • Identify and map relevant stakeholders, including decision-makers, influencers, users and potential internal champions.

  • Build multi-threaded relationships across different functions, seniority levels, regions and business units.

  • Develop targeted outreach strategies across email, phone, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

  • Engage senior stakeholders with relevant, insight-led messaging rather than relying on generic sales outreach.

  • Initiate meaningful conversations that uncover business challenges, priorities and potential opportunities.

  • Qualify prospects and assess whether there is a genuine business need and fit for Berlitz.

  • Create high-quality sales opportunities and ensure an effective handover to the relevant Global Account Manager or sales owner.

  • Work with Global Account Managers to develop and progress target accounts throughout the sales cycle.

  • Track prospecting activity, conversion and pipeline contribution, using data and insights to continuously improve your approach.

  • Share market, account and prospect insights with Sales, Marketing and other relevant teams.

  • Contribute to the development of Berlitz’s global-account prospecting playbook and ways of working as the sales organisation continues to evolve.

What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in B2B sales development, business development, inside sales or a similar commercial role, with strong outbound prospecting experience

  • Experience prospecting into enterprise or strategic accounts, ideally within a complex B2B environment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • German and Spanish are strongly preferred due to the global scope of the role.

  • A proven ability to engage and build relationships with senior stakeholders.

  • Strong research, stakeholder-mapping and account-planning skills, with the ability to turn account insights into relevant outreach.

  • Experience using a bottom-up, multi-threaded prospecting approach across complex organisations.

  • A consultative and commercially curious approach to prospecting — you want to understand the business problem rather than simply book a meeting.

  • Confidence communicating with senior decision-makers across different functions, markets and levels of an organisation.

  • A data-driven mindset and an understanding of key SDR metrics such as pipeline generation, conversion and meeting-to-opportunity rates.

  • A genuine interest in developing your career in B2B enterprise sales and progressing towards an Account Executive or Global Account Manager role.

Why Join Berlitz?

  • Be part of an exciting global transformation that is truly rare

  • Work alongside talented colleagues across the world

  • Have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact to help Berlitz connect the world through language and culture.

  • Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and supportive work environment.

At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow.

Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us.

jobs.title: Commercial Account Executive, DACH
Executive Business Partner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Executive Business Partner (m/w/d)

About us

We're on a mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. We close critical skill gaps in the workforce, in AI, data, engineering and more, through applied, guided and equitable learning programmes with measurable impact. Multiverse works with over 1,500 leading companies globally to solve business-critical skills challenges. We launched in Germany this year via our acquisition of StackFuel and our ambition is big: upskill 100,000 learners as soon as possible.

The role

Multiverse Germany's MD Office is looking for a proactive, tech-forward and experienced Executive Business Partner (m/w/d) to support the Managing Director (MD) and Chief of Staff (CoS), to help run a fast-growing Berlin office. Executive and business operations support is the core of this role: your responsibility will lie in managing the diary of the MD and other senior leaders, helping to drive our overall business operations and company rhythm. With competing priorities inevitably arising, this role will require you to use your judgment to prevent unnecessary involvement of the MD in day-to-day situations or proactively involve him or the CoS when urgent. You'll also work closely with the UK team to keep Multiverse Germany aligned with company-wide rhythms.

In addition to that, you’ll have the option to help build a high-performance, high-agency culture (e.g., owning the internal event calendar and other initiatives) in the Berlin office. In doing all of the above, automation with AI runs through all of what you’ll do. Wherever a process is repeatable, you're expected and excited to use AI tools to speed things up.

Key responsibilities:

  • Support the MD primarily and provide additional support to other senior leaders, as directed, to ensure that company goals and objectives are accomplished and that operations run efficiently

  • Maintain and refine internal processes that support the MD, leadership team and the company

  • Manage professional and personal scheduling for the MD, including calendar management, preparing agendas, drafting emails, preparing phone calls or customer meeting briefings

  • Manage the MDs and senior executives’ travel logistics and activities, including accommodations, transportation, and meals

  • Assist and manage all logistics from end-to-end of small to larger scale events, for example, company All-Hands, leadership offsites or one-off customer events

  • Coordinate closely with the UK and build relationships with UK-based Executive Business Partners, Business Operations Managers and teams so Germany stays aligned with company-wide meeting rhythms and conventions

  • Automate where you can and use AI tools to cut manual admin across scheduling, reporting and follow-up

Who you are:

  • You are comfortable in a constantly evolving environment: you can operate in a highly changing, fast-paced environment and prepare decisions, even when things are ambiguous and you can hold multiple threads at the same time

  • You are a strong communicator: you know when to raise a challenge, but even more so, you solve operational challenges them proactively before they reach the CoS or MD

  • You've done this before: several years as an EA, business or operations coordinator, or similar, ideally supporting leaders in a fast-paced or scaling environment

  • You think like an operator: you don't just execute tasks, you build the process, tracker or system behind them: every challenge is a problem about to be solved

  • You default to automation: you look to cut repeatable admin with AI tools rather than doing it by hand

  • You're discreet and trusted: you handle sensitive information with sound judgement

  • You're native or fluent in German, with strong conversational English: this is needed to coordinate closely with the UK team

  • Arbeite mit aktuellen Technologien und Standards wie Azure, Terraform, Kubenetes, Domain Driven Design, Micro Service Architekturen, OPC-UA oder MQTT.
  • Sei technischer Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und präsentiere technische Konzepte und Ergebnisse.

  • Wünschenswert sind außerdem gute Kenntnisse in Java Spring Boot und Python.
  • Du hast bereits Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, vorzugsweise in agilen Umgebungen.
  • Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes oder OpenShift sind keine Fremdwörter für dich.
  • Du bringst Interesse an Daten und KI-Lösungen mit.
  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet oder eine gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.
  • Du hast eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise und triffst technische Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn die Anforderungen noch nicht vollständig sind.
  • Du hast hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du scheust nicht davor zurück eng mit technischen Kundenansprechpartnern zu arbeiten und hast eine Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 80%.


Wie wir ticken

  • Jeder bei uns handelt, wie ein Entrepreneur: Wir lieben die Freiheit selbstbestimmt und mit Wirkung zu arbeiten. Wir fördern flache Hierarchien. Dies erreichen wir dadurch, dass jeder auf die eigene Person, Position und Fähigkeit angepasst wie ein Entrepreneur handelt.

  • Wir helfen Innovatoren zu gewinnen: Wir sind Evangelisten der Innovation! Innovation = Idee + Umsetzung + Mehrwert! Für uns steht es im Vordergrund, die Welt mit Innovationen zu verbessern. Bei unseren Kunden arbeiten wir oft mit Innovatoren zusammen, die viele Herausforderungen vor sich haben. Unser Ziel ist es, ihnen zu helfen erfolgreich mit Ihren Vorhaben zu sein.

  • Wir handeln eigenverantwortlich aber teamorientiert: Jeder und jede Einzelne übernimmt die Verantwortung für seine Aufgaben und Entscheidungen, behält dabei jedoch immer das gemeinsame Ziel und die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team im Blick. Es geht darum, selbstständig zu handeln und gleichzeitig die Stärken aller zu nutzen und zu fördern.

  • Wir überholen unsere Wettbewerber indem wir schneller lernen: In unserem Umfeld finden rasante Entwicklungen statt und der Markt ändert sich in hohem Tempo. Wir können nicht alles wissen, wollen uns aber konsequent weiterentwickeln, Neues ausprobieren und Erfahrungen rasch in Verbesserungen umsetzen. Durch diesen Fokus auf schnelles Lernen können wir zügiger auf Marktveränderungen reagieren und Innovationen vorantreiben.

  • Wir achten uns, die Dinge, die wir tun und wie wir diese tun: Wir behandeln uns selbst, unsere Mitmenschen und unsere Aufgaben mit Sorgfalt und Respekt. Dabei geht es nicht nur um das Ergebnis, sondern auch um den Weg dorthin – wir sind uns der Auswirkungen unseres Handelns bewusst und setzen uns für einen positiven Einfluss ein.

jobs.title: Werkstudent_in IT Service Management, Prozessmanagement & KI (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Werkstudent_in IT Service Management, Prozessmanagement & KI (m/w/d)
Wer wir sind

Die Audi Business Innovation GmbH (kurz: ABI) wurde 2013 als hundertprozentige Tochtergesellschaft der AUDI AG gegründet und spielt eine maßgebliche Rolle bei der Gestaltung des aktuellen digitalen Wandels in der Automobilindustrie.
 
Als Unternehmen, das sich auf digitale End-to-End Produktentwicklung und Innovation spezialisiert hat, entwickelt die Audi Business Innovation neuartige Produkte und Plattformen, mit dem Ziel, Audi Kunden ein ganzheitliches digitales Fahrerlebnis und mehr bewusste Zeit im Auto zu ermöglichen.
Die Expertise erstreckt sich von Trend- und Marktanalysen über die Entwicklung digitaler, kundenzentrierter Services und Geschäftsmodelle bis hin zu deren Implementierung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette.
 
Als Innovationsinkubator ist das Unternehmen Treiber der Entwicklung von zusätzlichen digitalen Angeboten rund um das Fahrzeug und darüber hinaus. Das Auto entwickelt sich vom reinen Fortbewegungsmittel immer mehr zum Experience Device. Parallel werden die Audi Fahrer_innen immer mehr zum User. Diesen Prozess treibt die Audi Business Innovation GmbH mit digitalen Services und Erlebnissen, die neu sind und den Audi Kund_innen in ihrem Lebensalltag unterstützen und inspirieren.

Die Audi Business Innovation GmbH hat ihren Sitz in München.

Werde Teil unseres Teams und unterstütze uns ab sofort mit bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche für mindestens 6 Monate.


Was dich auf deiner Mission erwartet

  • Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen unseren digitalen Produkten, Konzernmarken und internen Fachbereichen.
  • Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Teams passende Lösungen.
  • Du modellierst und visualisierst Prozesslandschaften innerhalb der AVP und unterstützt dabei, komplexe Abläufe für unterschiedliche Stakeholder transparent und verständlich darzustellen.
  • Du analysierst bestehende Confluence-Strukturen, entwickelst Konzepte für ein modernes Wissensmanagement und bereitest Inhalte für KI-gestützte Such- und Assistenzsysteme auf.
  • Du untersuchst Potenziale zur Automatisierung von Service- und Supportprozessen in Jira Service Management und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung entsprechender Konzepte und Prototypen.
  • Du evaluierst gemeinsam mit dem Team Einsatzmöglichkeiten von KI im Wissensmanagement, Service Management und der Prozessautomatisierung.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Durchführung agiler Events und förderst die Zusammenarbeit sowie den Wissensaustausch innerhalb der Teams.
  • Du führst Analysen, Umfragen und Auswertungen durch, entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Services ab.
  • Du erhältst Einblicke in Projektmanagement, Service Management und die Weiterentwicklung digitaler Produkte in einem agilen Umfeld.


Was du mitbringst

  • Du befindest dich in einem fortgeschrittenen Bachelor- oder Masterstudium, beispielsweise der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Digital Business oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.
  • Du interessierst dich für Themen wie IT Service Management (ITSM), Prozessmanagement, Wissensmanagement, Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI im Unternehmensumfeld.
  • Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Sachverhalte zu strukturieren, zu visualisieren und verständlich aufzubereiten.
  • Du denkst analytisch, hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe und entwickelst gerne neue Lösungsansätze auf Basis von Daten und Nutzeranforderungen.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und bringst eine hohe Lernbereitschaft mit.
  • Du kommunizierst gerne, arbeitest teamorientiert und hast Spaß daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.


Was wünschenswert wäre

  • Erste Kenntnisse im IT Service Management (ITSM), z. B. Incident-, Request- oder Change-Management 
  • Erste Erfahrungen mit Prozessdarstellungen, Flowcharts oder ähnlichen Methoden 
  • Interesse an Generative AI, Copilot, Atlassian Intelligence oder vergleichbaren Technologien
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit Projekt-, Prozess- oder Service Management.
  • Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Ticket- und Collaboration-Tools (z. B. Jira oder Confluence).
  • Erste Kenntnisse im Bereich Prozessmodellierung, Reporting oder Datenanalyse.
