jobs.title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende Immoblien-Intelligence-Plattform für ESG und Wert-Management in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.


Deine Mission

Als Head of Engineering übernimmst du die Führung unseres aktuell rund 10-köpfigen Engineering-Teams und baust es weiter aus. Du hilfst deinem Team, ambitioniert zu liefern: kontinuierliche Verbesserungen für unsere bestehenden Kunden, aber auch neue Prototypen und Innovationen, die unser Geschäftsmodell erweitern. Gleichzeitig sorgst du für Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit im Team, damit alle jeden Tag ein Stück besser werden.

Du bist ein starker Sparringspartner und denkst in Systemen: Gemeinsam mit unserem C-Level, dem Product- und Data-Team sowie unseren Kunden entwickelst du unsere Produktstrategie weiter und findest technisch tragfähige, smarte Lösungen. Bei uns gewinnt die beste Idee - egal von wem sie kommt. Mit 40 Leuten gibt's einfach keinen Raum für Politik.

Technisch baust du unsere Architektur so, dass sie mit uns skaliert und Raum für Innovation lässt - etwa bei der Integration von AI-Komponenten und Datenpipelines. Dabei hast du bei uns freie Hand: Neues ausprobieren, den Tech-Stack weiterentwickeln und auch Kapazität für technisches Fundament und Tech Debt einplanen.

So hilfst du auch unseren Sales- und Customer-Success-Teams, neue Kunden zu gewinnen - und baust dir damit deine eigene User- und Fan-Base auf. Und: Jede Zeile Code trägt dazu bei, den CO2-Fußabdruck von Immobilien zu verbessern.

Tech-Stack: TypeScript (Full Stack, React im Frontend, NestJS im Backend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL RDS, AWS ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, Claude


Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Du holst das Beste aus agentic engineering raus und erweiterst zusammen mit deinem Team die Plattform um eine 360°-Sicht auf die Immobilie.
  • Du hast das Team schneller liefern lassen - indem du es unterstützt, die Can-do-Mentalität stärkst und den Fokus auf die wirklich wichtigen Dinge setzt - bei Produkten und Architektur-Projekten.
  • Du hast das Team um starke Talente erweitert.
  • Du weißt, was jede Person in deinem Team antreibt - und hast ihr geholfen, die eigene Performance aufs nächste Level zu heben.


Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Software-Engineering-Führung und -Architektur, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz beim Skalieren von Engineering-Teams bei gleichzeitig hoher Shipping-Geschwindigkeit - idealerweise in einem Nicht-Konzernumfeld.
  • Du liebst es, Teams wachsen zu lassen, sie in ihrer Entwicklung zu unterstützen und ihnen gleichzeitig ambitionierte Ziele zu setzen.
  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit den genannten Frontend- und Backend-Technologien sowie modernen Tech-Stacks - nicht, indem du alles selbst codest, sondern indem du dein Team befähigst.
  • Du denkst in Systemen und löst Probleme konsequent aus einer First-Principles-Perspektive.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau bzw. C1 und fließend Englisch.


Warum Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit.

  • Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier aufbaust - Team, Architektur, ein Produkt, das Kunden wirklich nutzen - bleibt. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar: im Revenue, im Produkt und darin, wie das Engineering-Team in einem Jahr arbeitet.

  • Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.

  • Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.

  • Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 4 Tage/Woche.

jobs.title: Associate Data Scientist (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Associate Data Scientist (f/m/d)
Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.


Your Mission

As a Data Scientist at Predium, you will help develop and improve the data-driven models behind our platform. You will use statistics, machine learning, and numerical methods to solve well-defined problems related to buildings, energy performance, and real-estate decarbonization.
Working closely with our engineering and product team, you will turn real-world data into reliable analytical, simulation, and machine-learning models that identify optimization opportunities for more sustainable buildings and help customers make informed investment decisions.


What you'll own

  1. Develop and improve analytical, machine-learning, and simulation models to address business problems in the real-estate and energy domain.
  2. Build and improve data extraction pipelines for structured and unstructured sources, evaluating extraction accuracy and reliability
  3. Continuously explore and evaluate new data sources to improve model accuracy.
  4. Assess data quality, identify gaps and evaluate model performance by validating assumptions and results against real-world data and feedback of domain experts.
  5. Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into data-driven solutions.


What success looks like

  1. You take ownership of well-defined analytical and modeling problems and independently deliver robust solutions.
  2. Your models and analyses are reproducible, well-documented, and supported by appropriate validation.
  3. You translate technical results into clear implications for the product, our customers, and the business.
  4. You collaborate effectively across Data, Engineering and Product teams.
  5. You actively seek feedback and use it to improve both your technical work and your way of working.


What it takes

  1. A degree in data science, computer science, mathematics or a related field.
  2. 1–2 years of relevant hands-on experience, with programming, ideally in Python, through projects in areas such as physics-based modeling, machine learning, or data pipelines. TypeScript experience for product prototyping is a plus.
  3. A structured, independent approach to problem-solving.
  4. Curiosity about business needs and the ability to explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  5. Confident communication in English; German is a plus.
Bonus:
  1. Initial experience with optimization methods, LLM-based data extraction, or uncertainty and sensitivity analysis.
  2. Familiarity with real estate, building physics, or energy systems.
  3. Experience with tools for physical simulation or energy modeling.


Why Predium?

jobs.description:
Director, Mobility Partnerships

Material Bank is the world's largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.

As Director, Mobility Partnerships, you will lead Material Bank's expansion into the global mobility interiors market, building strategic partnerships with leading brands across automotive, aviation, and marine. This is not a traditional sales role—it is an opportunity to establish a new vertical by leveraging deep industry expertise, trusted relationships, and commercial acumen.

You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and securing founding brand partners while serving as Material Bank's representative within a highly specialized industry. Success in this role requires credibility, confidence, and the ability to build long-term relationships with senior leaders across Europe and North America. You understand the business, speak the language of the industry, and know how to create value beyond the transaction.

This is a senior, external-facing role for someone who has spent their career within the mobility interiors ecosystem. You thrive in face-to-face conversations, industry events, customer visits, and executive meetings, knowing that lasting partnerships are built through trust and personal relationships. The role is Europe-based and requires extensive international travel (approximately 80–90%) across Europe and North America, with significant focus on Germany, Switzerland, and the Netherlands.

What you'll do

  • Build Material Bank's founding portfolio of mobility interior brand partners across automotive, aviation, and marine.
  • Own the full business development lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and developing relationships through negotiation and partnership execution.
  • Represent Material Bank at industry trade shows, conferences, and customer events, building awareness and establishing credibility within the mobility interiors community.
  • Develop trusted relationships with executives, commercial leaders, designers, specification teams, and decision-makers across leading manufacturers and suppliers.
  • Lead consultative business conversations that demonstrate how Material Bank creates value through material discovery, digital sampling, specification tools, and market insights.
  • Partner closely with Product, Catalog, Marketing, and Leadership to shape Material Bank's strategy for the mobility sector, bringing customer and market insights back into the business.
  • Identify market opportunities, competitive trends, and emerging technologies that influence the future of mobility interiors.
  • Serve as a trusted industry expert, helping establish Material Bank as the leading platform for mobility material discovery.

What you'll bring

  • 15+ years of experience within the mobility interiors industry, ideally in automotive, aviation, marine, or a related materials manufacturing environment.
  • Deep knowledge of the European mobility market, with an established network of manufacturers, suppliers, OEMs, and industry leaders.
  • A proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence senior executives through credibility, expertise, and a consultative approach.
  • Strong commercial instincts with experience developing new business and closing strategic partnerships.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build a business, create opportunities, and operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Exceptional communication skills and executive presence, with confidence engaging customers, partners, and industry leaders.
  • Experience representing organizations at industry events and trade shows.
  • Highly self-motivated, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 75%) throughout Europe and North America.

Material Bank connects design professionals to hundreds of manufacturers through facilitating brand discovery, sales rep engagement, and material sampling. jobs.description:
Expert Assurance | Courtage & IA @Panora (backed by Hexa)

À propos de Panora

Panora est une plateforme d'IA native pour les courtiers en assurance. Nos agents IA automatisent les workflows à forte friction, cotation, comparaison de contrats, analyse des garanties, vérification de conformité, génération de documents et produisent des résultats structurés et actionnables en quelques minutes plutôt qu'en heures.

Nous accompagnons les cabinets de courtage en France et en Belgique, avec une conviction claire : le courtage en assurance est opérationnellement dysfonctionnel depuis des décennies, et l'IA est enfin le bon outil pour y remédier. L'IA n'est plus optionnelle pour les courtiers : elle devient le standard. La question n'est plus si, mais à quel point elle est bien mise en œuvre.

Panora a été fondée par Diane et Fabian. Diane a passé plusieurs années en capital-risque avec une solide expérience opérationnelle et connaît de l'intérieur les défis du scaling de business complexes. Fabian est un fondateur multi-récidiviste et ingénieur IA orienté produit, pionnier dans la construction de systèmes IA qui fonctionnent vraiment en production. Ensemble, ils ont décidé de créer Panora pour transformer les opérations d'assurance en avantage concurrentiel en temps réel pour les courtiers.

Panora est soutenue par Hexa (anciennement eFounders), le studio de startups pionnier en Europe, qui a lancé plus de 35 entreprises dont des licornes comme Front, Aircall et Spendesk.

Pourquoi ce rôle existe

Nous avons construit une IA qui lit des contrats, compare des garanties et génère des analyses de couverture à grande échelle. La technologie fonctionne. Nous avons maintenant besoin de quelqu'un qui la rende brillante : quelqu'un d'assez méticuleux pour détecter chaque lacune, d'assez expérimenté pour savoir ce qui compte vraiment dans une police, et d'assez curieux pour vouloir façonner l'IA de l'intérieur.

Vous serez le cerveau assurance de Panora, la personne qui examine ce que notre IA produit, vérifie chaque synthèse, et réinjecte son expertise dans le système pour qu'il s'améliore en continu. C'est une opportunité unique de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur et de participer activement à la construction du futur du courtage.

Vos responsabilités

  • Vérification des outputs IA, contrat par contrat. Vous examinez les synthèses, analyses de couverture et recommandations générées par notre IA. Vous vérifiez leur exactitude, corrigez les erreurs et garantissez que chaque output répond au niveau d'exigence qu'un courtier engagerait sa réputation à défendre. Votre œil méticuleux est la dernière ligne de défense avant que les outputs n'atteignent les clients.

  • La boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA plus intelligente. Vous identifiez les schémas dans ce que l'IA réussit et rate. Vous travaillez avec les équipes produit et engineering pour réinjecter votre expertise assurance dans le système — améliorer les prompts, affiner le raisonnement, encoder les nuances que seules des années d'expérience permettent de saisir.

  • Accompagnement client et confiance. Vous soutenez l'onboarding des clients et leur usage au quotidien, en aidant les courtiers à comprendre et faire confiance aux outputs de l'IA. Quand des questions surgissent, vous apportez la crédibilité et l'expertise nécessaires pour expliquer, rassurer ou corriger.

  • Expertise assurance en IARD et Santé. Vous apportez une expertise approfondie en assurance dommages (IARD) et en assurance santé : les deux piliers de notre produit actuel. Vous en maîtrisez les spécificités et garantissez que notre IA traite les deux avec précision.

Votre profil

  • Expérience en tant que courtier, souscripteur, ou dans un rôle d'analyse technique des couvertures

  • Expertise approfondie en IARD et/ou santé : vous connaissez ces produits sur le bout des doigts

  • Méticuleux de nature : vous êtes la personne qui repère l'exclusion enfouie page 47

  • Vous lisez un contrat et identifiez immédiatement ce qui compte, ce qui manque, et ce qui pourrait nuire à un client

  • Vous écrivez clairement et savez expliquer des concepts complexes d'assurance à des non-experts

  • Vous êtes sincèrement curieux de ce que l'IA change pour notre secteur, enthousiaste à l'idée de le vivre de l'intérieur et d'y contribuer

  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté et attachez plus d'importance au métier de l'assurance qu'au confort de la routine

  • Français courant ; l'anglais est un plus

Ce rôle est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez passé des années à maîtriser l'assurance et souhaitez encoder cette expertise dans un produit qui transforme l'industrie

  • L'idée de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur vous enthousiasme, pas seulement utiliser des outils, mais les construire

  • Vous êtes méticuleux, rigoureux, et mettez un point d'honneur à bien faire les choses

  • Vous aimez accompagner les clients et les aider à réussir

  • Vous voulez rejoindre suffisamment tôt pour façonner ce que doit être le courtage assisté par IA

Ce rôle n'est pas fait pour vous si

  • Vous cherchez un poste de courtage traditionnel avec un portefeuille clients et des objectifs commerciaux

  • Vous préférez la routine à la construction from scratch

  • Les détails vous ennuient

Ce qui rend ce rôle unique

  • Vous rejoignez à un stade où le produit est suffisamment jeune pour que votre expertise façonne directement son intelligence

  • Vous vérifierez et améliorerez les outputs IA en IARD, Santé, et au-delà au fil de notre expansion

  • Vous faites partie de la boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA continuellement plus intelligente

  • Vous vivez la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur — un point de vue rare dans le secteur

  • Vous êtes un membre fondateur d'une équipe qui construit l'OS IA pour les courtiers européens. Cela signifie une vraie ownership, un vrai impact, et une trajectoire qui évolue avec Panora.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Responsabilité de niveau fondateur et impact direct sur le produit

  • Votre expertise assurance devient l'intelligence du produit

  • Une place au premier rang de la transformation IA en assurance, vue de l'intérieur

  • Courbe d'apprentissage intense à l'intersection de l'assurance et de l'IA

  • Package de rémunération compétitif, incluant des equity

  • Travaillez depuis les bureaux d'Hexa aux côtés de fondateurs, d'opérateurs et d'autres startups en early stage

Processus de recrutement

  1. Call intro avec l'équipe Talent d'Hexa (30 minutes)

  2. Call fit avec Diane pour comprendre votre parcours et votre expertise (30 minutes)

  3. Un scénario assurance réel : examiner une synthèse générée par l'IA, identifier les lacunes et expliquer comment vous amélioreriez l'output (à faire chez vous + restitution de 45 minutes avec Diane et Fabian)

  4. Une rencontre avec Fabien (CTO)

  5. Un entretien avec Matthieu, Partner chez Hexa

Panora s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés sans distinction de genre, origine, identité, parcours ou orientation sexuelle.

Nous savons qu'il reste beaucoup à faire en matière de diversité dans notre secteur, c'est pourquoi nous encourageons toutes les candidatures — en particulier celles issues de milieux sous-représentés.

Today, successful software companies have two ways to support and finance their growth: the VC path, and the self-financed profitable path. For software companies that can’t or do not want to bootstrap, but haven’t managed to stay permanently on hyper-growth, the VC path is a dead-end.

At Hexa Scale, we’re on a mission to solve this: offer a new alternative to fund and scale software companies towards exponential growth.

We believe that there are great software companies, still early stages in the 1-10m€ ARR range, that sit on amazing markets with a great product, but that require a few changes to unlock their potential.

We believe that by providing them with capital and strong operational leverage, we can put them on the right trajectory, towards category-leading exponential growth. Our full manifesto.

Your role is to help us find, select and invest in those companies.

Within Hexa Scale’s team (Thibault, Augustin & Samuel), you’ll participate in the deal-flow cycle to make 2/3 successful deals a year.

jobs.description:
Senior Broadcast Systems Engineer, EMEA

Role Overview

The Senior Broadcast Systems Engineer (Pre-Sales), EMEA is a strategic, customer-facing technical leader within NETGEAR's growing Broadcast business. Combining deep expertise in IP networking and broadcast workflows with strong commercial awareness, you will support partners, influence solution design, and drive adoption of NETGEAR solutions across EMEA.

As the technical face of NETGEAR in the broadcast ecosystem, you will work closely with OEM partners, system integrators, production facilities, and enterprise studios - validating solutions, supporting pre-sales engagements, and positioning NETGEAR as the trusted networking partner for modern IP-based media environments.

This is a UK-based role with regional responsibility across EMEA. Frequent travel, including internationally, of up to 60% is required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior technical authority for IP networking within broadcast and live production environments across EMEA

  • Lead pre-sales engagements by designing and validating network architectures for broadcast and professional A/V customers

  • Collaborate with OEM partners (e.g., Riedel, EVS, Clear-Com, Panasonic, Grass Valley) to ensure interoperability and joint solution alignment

  • Design and support IP-based media workflows including AES67, Dante, Ravenna, SMPTE ST 2110, NDI, and IPMX

  • Build and maintain lab environments, testbeds, and demos for validation, partner enablement, and customer engagements

  • Partner with Sales, Business Development, and Alliances to drive technical win strategies and shape solution design early in the sales cycle

  • Deliver technical enablement for internal SE teams and partners through training, documentation, and best practices

  • Provide field feedback to Product and Engineering on switching performance, multicast behaviour, QoS, redundancy models, and timing-sensitive environments

  • Represent NETGEAR at industry events such as NAB, IBC, and InfoComm through demos, presentations, and thought leadership

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience in broadcast, live production, or professional A/V environments combined with a strong foundation in IP networking

  • Practical knowledge of broadcast audio and IP video technologies: AES67, Dante, Ravenna, SMPTE ST 2110, NDI, and IPMX

  • Experience supporting production facilities, OB trucks, post-production, intercom systems, or enterprise studios

  • Prior customer-facing experience in pre-sales engineering, system design, or technical consulting

  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing teams

  • Willingness to travel frequently (up to 60%), including internationally across EMEA

Core Technical Skills

  • Layer 2/3 networking: VLANs, link aggregation, and network segmentation

  • Multicast design and troubleshooting: IGMP behaviour, scaling, and optimisation

  • QoS design for real-time media traffic, including prioritisation of latency- and timing-sensitive flows

  • Timing and synchronisation in IP media networks: PTP concepts, clocking considerations, and network impact

  • Redundancy and high-availability design for media networks

  • Bandwidth planning and traffic modelling for high-bandwidth video environments

  • Scalable network topologies including spine-leaf architectures

jobs.description:
Client Solutions Manager - Influencer Marketing | UK

About Kyra

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.


📍London (Hybrid)
💰 Competitive, dependent on experience

The Opportunity

You will be work on of one of Kyra's largest and most complex global enterprise accounts: a fast-moving, multi-category consumer brand with 12+ sub-brands, 35+ active stakeholders, and campaigns running simultaneously across multiple regions.

Your job is to keep delivery tight, keep the client happy, and be a safe pair of hands on a flagship account. This is not about growing or expanding the account. The commercial relationship is locked in. The job is world-class servicing at enterprise scale.

What you'll do:

  • Work on the global account relationship across 12+ sub-brands and multiple regions. Stay organised across a volume of comms, briefs, and stakeholders that is genuinely unusual.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams: creative, paid media, creator partnerships, and product. You are the connective tissue. If something drifts, you see it early and fix it.

  • If something drifts (performance, scope, relationship, or timeline) you see it early and fix it. No surprises. Steady, organised ownership.


🎯 Co-own the Relationship Work on client relationships across product launches, seasonal campaigns, and always-on programmes. Multi-thread across their teams. Build trust at every level. Have direct conversations when performance needs to improve.

📈 Turn Insight into Strategy Translate campaign data into clear, executive-level recommendations using AI to move from raw numbers to narrative faster. Present performance against KPIs (engagement, EMV, sales lift, affiliate impact) and explain what it means.

🔍 Work On Delivery End-to-End Lead client onboarding for new briefs: build decks, verify SOW accuracy, coordinate internal teams, demo the platform. Manage timelines, scopes, budgets, and execution across our full product suite, including Always-On creator partnerships, Pulse campaigns, Makers (CGC), Amplify+ (paid boosting), Seeding+, and License+. With 6+ briefs running simultaneously, operational precision is everything. Keep work on-brand, on-time, and within margin.

📊 Protect & Grow Revenue Lead post-campaign analysis: run internal post-mortems, build PCA decks, present performance narratives. Work on exec-ready reporting (QBRs/EBRs). Reporting should inform decisions, not just recap them.

🛡️ Keep the System Tight Keep tracking clean. Watch capacity. Fix what's inefficient. Make sure client feedback doesn't get lost. Feed client insights back into product development.

Feed Insight Back into Product Surface client needs, pain points, and feature requests back into the product team. You are the closest person to how the client actually uses the platform.

 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who has:

  • 4–6+ years in influencer or creator marketing

  • Campaign execution experience. You have actually run creator marketing activations, not just managed client relationships from a distance.

  • Enterprise account servicing at scale. Multi-stakeholder, high-volume, complex. You have managed accounts with this many moving parts before.

  • Exceptional organisation. The volume of comms, briefs, regions, and stakeholders on this account is unusually high. Getting lost is easy. You don't get lost.

  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset. You take work on learning, build internal relationships proactively, and don't wait to be told what to do.

  • Strong hands-on campaign experience, with real fluency in TikTok.

  • AI fluency, applied. Our platform is AI-powered and you'll be expected to get up to speed fast and use it daily for client summaries, performance narratives, and campaign analysis. We're looking for people already comfortable using AI tools in their workflow, so the learning curve is the platform, not the concept.

  • Comfortable working across project management tools (Asana, Airtable, Slack) and reporting dashboards.

  • CPG or multi-category consumer brand experience is a plus.

  • Bonus if you're English and Spanish bilingual speaking.

You should be commercially sharp, operationally reliable, and able to speak confidently about the accounts you've managed.

Traits That Matter
Proactive. Organised. Adaptable. Self-starting. Comfortable with ambiguity.

You don't wait for problems to land. You see them coming and act. You don't need rigid processes or hand-holding. Tools, product, and ways of working evolve constantly here, and you thrive on that.

You're willing to say "I don't know" and go find out. You take feedback well. You build trust fast.

Nice to have

If you speak one of these languages - Spanish, French, German, Italian

What Success Looks Like What Success Looks Like

By Month 1: You have full context on all active sub-brands, briefs, and stakeholders. You've built a strong working relationship with the Campaign Director and the internal pod. The client knows your name and trusts you to run things.

By Month 3: Delivery is running smoothly across all regions. You work on reporting and client comms without oversight. Post-campaign analysis is sharp and drives clear recommendations. Internal teams come to you, not around you.

By Month 6: The account is in better shape than when you arrived. Stakeholder satisfaction is high. Nothing has been dropped. Leadership trusts your judgement completely.

Benefits

🏢 Hybrid working. 3 days per week in-office, 4 days during your first 2 weeks of onboarding.
🌴 Annual Time Off: 25 days PTO (pro-rated) + bank holidays (pro-rated), 4 company-wide days off (Kyra Days), 3 wellness days, and paid sick leave each year

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.

Account Executive Enterprise UKI

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Own a specific geographical region or country within the EMEA market which includes target-accounts and an existing book of business that has companies with 3000+ employees. Primary focus is on hunting new business opportunities, building sales pipeline, and driving growth within the ENT sector. Upscaling existing account base through expansion and upsell, leveraging our Extended Access Management Identity.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Expectations of this role

This is a hybrid role with a regular travel component. You will be expected to work from 1Password’s London office 3 days per week, with the flexibility to work from the office up to 5 days per week based on business needs.
You will also regularly engage in customer-facing activities, including in-person meetings, events, and other travel required to effectively support your territory. Travel within your assigned territory, and occasionally outside of it, will be a part of your job, and you are responsible for managing your schedule in a way that works for the company and you.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably in security with a focus on Enterprise accounts OR top performance in MidMarket/Commercial and ready to step up.

  • Familiarity with the UK region.

  • Demonstrated success in owning and growing a geographical territory or country within the UK.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and KPIs.

  • Outstanding sales skills in prospecting, pipeline building, strategic account planning, value-based selling, and territory management, with meticulous operating rigor in pipeline management, forecasting, and pacing to target

  • Demonstrated success in upselling & cross-selling to both new customers and across a book of business, and in uncovering customer pain points beyond what's initially shared

  • Proficient skills in business acumen, negotiation, relationship building, communication & presentation skills to C-Suite

  • Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate complex cybersecurity concepts, particularly in Identity and Access Management.

  • Self-motivated, driven, and able to work independently in a remote setting.

  • Preferable proficiency with Salesforce, Slack, Zoom, LinkedIn Sales Navigator & Outreach

Please note that this job description is subject to modifications and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities.

What you can expect:

  • Own Your Territory: Manage and grow your designated geographical region or country within EMEA, focusing on acquiring new ENT clients and expanding existing accounts.

  • Manage Pipeline: Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through proactive prospecting (cold calling, and networking), supplemented with inbound leads and effective pipeline development inline with our sales methodology.

  • Drive New Business Growth: Key Activities for effective sales strategies to meet and exceed sales targets including:

    • Strategic Territory Segmentation: Refine client targeting by segmenting against Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) that align with enterprise needs and priorities.

    • Contextual Business Understanding & Multithreading: Develop deep insights into the enterprise's structure, key decision-makers, and buying processes. Implement multithreading to engage various stakeholders across departments, ensuring broad influence and deeper engagement.

    • Excellence in Outbound & Pipeline Generation: Leverage a combination of self-generated outreach, BDR collaboration, and marketing-driven initiatives to consistently build a high-quality pipeline.

    • Tailored Discovery & Scoping: Align 1Password’s value to the enterprise's unique challenges through comprehensive discovery and scoping, ensuring that proposed solutions are relevant and impactful at scale.

    • Continuous Improvement via Coaching: Maintain a growth mindset by actively participating in high-quality coaching sessions, driving incremental improvements in sales performance weekly

  • Drive Organic Growth: Identify opportunities to expand and cross-sell 1Password’s solutions within existing accounts by building key stakeholder relationships and leveraging your understanding of Extended Access Management.

  • Engage the Industry: Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to represent 1Password, build brand presence and build relationships with potential customers

  • Stay Informed: Stay up to date on cybersecurity trends and developments, particularly in Identity and Access Management, to provide valuable insights to clients and position 1Password as an industry leader.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally:

    • Internal Collaboration: Foster strong partnerships with internal teams such as BDR, Solutions, Channels, Onboarding, and Customer Success to craft tailored solutions that address the complex needs of enterprise clients, ensuring alignment across the customer journey.

    • Multithreaded Client Engagement: Develop and maintain relationships across multiple stakeholders within enterprise client organizations, including C-level, IT, and security teams. This approach ensures a comprehensive understanding of the client's business, enhancing account health and expanding long-term value.

  • Focus on Solution-Driven Selling:

    • Implement 1Password methodology to ensure our solutions are strategically aligned with client goals and tailored to their specific needs.

    • Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of client challenges, and position our offerings as impactful, customized solutions that drive value and outcomes.

  • Present and Negotiate:

    • Confidently present to executives, articulating the value proposition of our products and services.

    • Create mutual action plans to align the sales team and prospects on responsibilities, steps and timelines for closing deals.

    • Utilize effective negotiation skills to drive mutually beneficial outcomes.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £87,000 GBP and £126,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits

You belong here.

Junior Strategist, UK Based

About Kyra

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

As a Junior Strategist at Kyra, you’ll help develop platform-native campaign strategies that combine creative storytelling with measurable brand impact. Working alongside our Strategists and Strategy Director, you’ll contribute to strategy from pitch through to post-campaign — turning insights into creative ideas that resonate across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and beyond.

You’ll collaborate closely with Client Solutions, Campaign Management, Paid Media, and Business Development to support campaigns for our enterprise accounts. This role is ideal for someone early in their strategy career who lives on TikTok, loves turning data into narrative, and wants to grow fast in the creator economy.

Reporting to: Strategy Director

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

💡 Strategic Campaign Development

  • Support the development of campaign strategies — contributing to audience profiling, creator casting logic, content formats, messaging, and performance KPIs

  • Work cross-functionally with internal teams to help craft platform-native campaign concepts that align with brand tone and commercial goals

  • Write clear, inspiring creator-facing briefs informed by data and social insights, translating client objectives into platform-native content

📊 Insights, Data & Measurement

  • Track and report against measurement frameworks across CPV, ER, and platform-specific KPIs

  • Use first-party, platform, and audience data to inform targeting, creative direction, and optimisation

  • Support Paid Media and Client Solutions in interpreting results and shaping strategic recommendations

🔍 Trend Forecasting & Cultural Analysis

  • Own day-to-day cultural listening, market research, and platform trend tracking within the fashion and beauty categories

  • Translate emerging insights into campaign ideas and brand opportunities

  • Contribute trend insights and POVs to decks, pitches, and proposals for new business

📞 Client Engagement

  • Join client calls alongside senior team members and present sections of strategic recommendations

  • Support Account and Campaign Leads in responding to briefs and evolving campaign strategy based on feedback

WHAT YOU BRING

🔑 Early Strategy Experience in the Creator Space

  • 1–3 years in strategy, planning, insights, social, or branded content — agency, in-house, or strong internship experience in a creator, beauty, fashion, or social-first environment

⭐ The Traits We’re Looking For

  • Chronically online: Instinctively in tune with social platforms and emerging behaviours

  • Culturally fluent: Actively tracks trends, conversations, and cultural shifts across platforms

  • Creator-briefing expertise: Experienced in translating strategy into clear, compelling creator direction

  • Exceptional writing: Communicates ideas with clarity, creativity, and precision

  • Relevant category experience: Strong understanding of the fashion and beauty landscapes

  • Data-led thinking: Confident interpreting performance metrics and applying insights

  • Creator marketing expertise: Deep understanding of creators, platforms, and effective partnerships

  • AI fluency: Comfortable using AI tools to strengthen thinking, creativity, and efficiency

What Makes You Stand Out

  • A hybrid thinker who blends logic with creativity, intuition with structure

  • Examples of trend analysis, social content, or campaign thinking you’ve produced — professionally or personally

  • Passion for fashion, beauty, and social culture — and for pushing the boundaries of what creator content can do

BENEFITS

🌎 We’re a remote-first team, giving you the flexibility to work from wherever you do your best work

🌴 Annual Time Off: 25 days PTO + bank holidays, 4 company-wide days off (Kyra Days), 3 wellness days, and paid sick leave each year

📚 Growth: Annual Learning & Development budget to invest in your skills

💰 Rewards: Annual bonus scheme to recognise great work

🩺 Healthcare coverage for US-based team members

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. But everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

 

💟 Support

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.
